# Load libraries and data
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggOceanMaps)

load("data/UVP6_combined_carbon_predictions_20250411.RData")


theme_set(theme_bw())
`%notin%` <- Negate(`%in%`)
```

# Work on the 15 casts that reach sequestration depth for now
```{r}
# Establish the depth bins
binsize <-  100
uvp6_ecopartBin <- uvp6_ecopart %>% 
  mutate(depthBin = floor(Depth_5m/binsize)*binsize) %>% 
  group_by(sample_id, depthBin) %>% 
  summarise(volume_m3 = sum(Sampled_volume_m3),
            nbins = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(binsize = binsize) %>% 
  mutate(depthRange = paste0(depthBin,"m - ",depthBin+binsize,"m"))
uvp6_ecopartBin <- uvp6_ecopartBin %>% 
  mutate(depthRange = factor(depthRange,
                             levels = unique(uvp6_ecopartBin$depthRange)))

cope_bin_deep <- cope_carbon %>% 
  filter(!is.na(structural_carbon)) %>% 
  left_join(cope_carbon_meta, by = "object_id") %>% 
  # Add the total volume for the depth bin
  mutate(depthBin = floor(Depth_5m/binsize)*binsize) %>% 
  
  # Only select casts that go beyond 1000 m
  group_by(sample_id) %>% 
  mutate(maxdepth = max(depthBin)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(maxdepth >= 1000) %>% 
  
  select(-c(Depth_5m, Sampled_volume_L, Sampled_volume_m3)) %>% 
  left_join(uvp6_ecopartBin,
            by = join_by(sample_id, depthBin)) %>% 
  # Calculate the abundance and carbon density per depth bin (/m3)
  # TODO can bin by data source here too
  group_by(sample_id, depthBin, depthRange,
           lon, lat, Year, Month, DOY, volume_m3) %>% 
  summarise(abundance = n(), #
            structural_carbon = sum(structural_carbon),
            waxester_carbon = sum(waxester_carbon),
            total_carbon = sum(total_carbon),
            lf_carbon_mean = mean(lf_carbon),
            lf_carbon_sd = sd(lf_carbon),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(abundance_m3 = abundance / volume_m3,
         structural_carbon_m3 = structural_carbon / volume_m3,
         waxester_carbon_m3 = waxester_carbon / volume_m3,
         total_carbon_m3 = total_carbon / volume_m3) %>% 
  select(-c(structural_carbon, waxester_carbon,
            total_carbon)) %>% 
  droplevels()


cowplot::plot_grid(
  ggplot(cope_bin_deep, aes(y = abundance_m3,
                            x = depthRange)) +
    geom_boxplot(outliers = FALSE) +
    geom_point(aes(color = lat), size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(x = "", y = "Abundance (indiv/m3)") +
    theme(legend.position = "none") +
    scale_x_discrete(limits = rev) +
    scale_color_viridis_c(),
  
  ggplot(cope_bin_deep, aes(y = total_carbon_m3,
                            x = depthRange)) +
    geom_boxplot(outliers = FALSE) +
    geom_point(aes(color = lat), size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(x = "", y = "Total carbon (mg C/m3)") +
    theme(legend.position = "none") +
    scale_x_discrete(limits = rev) +
    scale_color_viridis_c(),
  
  ggplot(cope_bin_deep, aes(y = waxester_carbon_m3,
                            x = depthRange)) +
    geom_boxplot(outliers = FALSE) +
    geom_point(aes(color = lat), size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(x = "", y = "Wax ester carbon (mg C/m3)") +
    theme(legend.position = "none") +
    scale_x_discrete(limits = rev) +
    scale_y_log10()+
    scale_color_viridis_c(),
  
  ggplot(cope_bin_deep, aes(y = lf_carbon_mean,
                            x = depthRange)) +
    geom_boxplot(outliers = FALSE) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 50, color = "pink") +
    geom_point(aes(color = lat), size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(x = "", y = "Average lipid fullness (%total C)") +
    theme(legend.position = "none") +
    scale_x_discrete(limits = rev) +
    scale_color_viridis_c(),
  labels = "auto"
)

ggsave("figures/UVP6_vertical_15_deep_v2.png",
       height = 9, width = 10, units = "in")
```

# Process of calculating carbon export...
In Tarling et al. (2022), the diapause duration is when the 80% fraction of lipids is respired. The respiration rate they used was based on Visser et al. (2017)
```{r}
# 1. Tarling et al. (2022)
# Respiration rate based on Visser et al. (2017)
# resp <- b * (mass^(3/4)) * exp(E * (T- T0)/(k*T*T0))
# b is the universal scaling constant: 2.3 × 10−7 ugC1/4 s−1 # note that in Jonnasdottir et al. (2019) this value 2.5 but also referencing Visser et al. (2017) which actually uses 2.3
# E is the activation energy: 0.6 eV
# k is the Boltzmann constant: eV K-1 [Value not reported in table but is 8.62 10−5 eV K-1]
# T and T0 are in Kelvin, Assume average 0.5 degC at depth?
# T0 is absolute zero? That is the case in Tarling and in Jonnasdottir but Visser et al. (2017) which they reference actually reports T0 as 273 K (which is zero degree celsius)... it is also 273.15 K for Schmid et al. (2018)
# Diapause duration was set as time to respire 80% of lipid reserves according to Saumweber and Durbin (2006).


# resp <-  (2.3*10^-7) * (mass^0.75) * exp(0.6 * (273.65--273)/ (273.65*-273))
# diap_dur <- (w - 0.2w)/resp

# Note that because diapausing depth temperature is around 0 degC, the temperature term is not even used since the value of the exp() ~ 1

carbexp <- cope_carbon %>% # Can be individual level 
  filter(!is.na(structural_carbon)) %>% 
  # TODO remove anomalously low structural carbon values
  filter(structural_carbon > 0.05) %>% 
  mutate(mass_ugC = structural_carbon * 1000) %>% 
  # mutate(respirationRate_ugCs = (2.3*10^-7) * (mass_ugC^0.75) * exp(0.6 * (273.65--273)/ (273.65*-273))) %>% 
  mutate(respirationRate_ugCs_Tarling = (2.3*10^-7) * (mass_ugC^0.75) * exp(0.6 * (273.65-273)/ ((8.62*10^-5)*273.65*273))) %>% 
  
# In Maps et al. (2014), the E = 0.55 ev, Metabolic constant based on Fig 1 is 1.5x10^-7, while allometric exponent used was 0.75 (Although the equation reports 0.78+-0.09)
  mutate(respirationRate_ugCs_Maps = (1.5*10^-7) * (mass_ugC^0.75) * exp(0.55 * (273.65-273)/ ((8.62*10^-5)*273.65*273))) %>% 
  
  mutate(diapauseDuration_day_Tarling = 
           (0.8*waxester_carbon*1000)/(respirationRate_ugCs_Tarling* 86400)) %>% 
  
  mutate(diapauseDuration_day_Maps = 
           (0.8*waxester_carbon*1000)/(respirationRate_ugCs_Maps* 86400))
  

# Add depth info and filter samples
carbexp2 <- carbexp %>% 
  left_join(cope_carbon_meta %>% 
              select(object_id, depth, sample_id)) %>% 
  filter(depth >= 600) %>% 
  mutate(source = factor(source,
                         levels = c("annotated","visible","not visible",
                                    "random forest")))

summary(carbexp2 %>% select(respirationRate_ugCs_Tarling, respirationRate_ugCs_Maps,
                           diapauseDuration_day_Tarling,
                           diapauseDuration_day_Maps))

clrs <- c("black","hotpink","blue2","plum1","purple4","tomato","gold1")


# Using the Maps et al. (2014) results in longer diapause durations
cowplot::plot_grid(
  ggplot(carbexp2 %>% 
           select(total = total_carbon, waxester = waxester_carbon, structural = structural_carbon) %>% 
           pivot_longer(cols = c(total, waxester, structural),
                        names_to = "carbon", values_to = "val") %>% 
           mutate(carbon = factor(carbon, levels = c("total","structural","waxester"))),
         aes(x = val, color = carbon, fill = carbon)) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.4) +
    scale_x_log10() +
    xlab("carbon content (mg C)") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = clrs) + 
    scale_color_manual(values = clrs) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom"),
  
  ggplot(carbexp2,
         aes(x = lf_carbon)) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.4) +
    xlab("lipid fullness (% total carbon)") +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom"),
  
  
  ggplot(carbexp2 %>% 
           select(Tarling2022 = respirationRate_ugCs_Tarling, Maps2014 = respirationRate_ugCs_Maps) %>% 
           pivot_longer(cols = c(Tarling2022, Maps2014),
                        names_to = "basis", values_to = "val"),
         aes(x = val, color = basis, fill = basis)) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.4) +
    scale_x_log10() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = clrs) + 
    scale_color_manual(values = clrs) +
    xlab("individual diapause respiration rate (ug C s-1)") +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom"),
  
  
  ggplot(carbexp2 %>% 
           select(Tarling2022 = diapauseDuration_day_Tarling, Maps2014 = diapauseDuration_day_Maps) %>% 
           pivot_longer(cols = c(Tarling2022, Maps2014),
                        names_to = "basis", values_to = "val"),
         aes(x = val, color = basis, fill = basis)) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.4) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = clrs) + 
    scale_color_manual(values = clrs) +
    xlab("diapause duration (days)") +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom"),
  labels = "auto"
)
```

# Tarling et al. (2022) method for carbon export
1. The total respiration flux is the summation of the product of abundance * diapause duration * respiration rate at each depth layer
2. Overwintering non-predatory mortality rate (beta) = -0.001 day-1
3. The total flux of the stored lipid and structural carbon from overwintering mortality is the fraction of the abundance lost to natural mortality multiplied by either the stored lipid or structural lipid carbon mass.
4. The total C flux is the sum of the total respiration flux + total stored lipid mortality flux + structural carbon mortality flux (ug C m-2 year-1)

The version of this here (need to verify):
1. At each depth bin, calculate the total diapause respiration rate (ug C m-2) by multiplying the depth of the bin layer (100 m) * total of (individual respiration rate ug C s-1) / volume filtered in the depth layer (m-3) * diapause duration (days)
2. Calculate proportion of the assemblage subjected to overwintering mortality at each depth bin. Based on total abundance of the depth bin? Or the abundance represented by each individual and then sum all individuals?
```{r}
beta <- -0.001 # day-1
carbexp_tarling <- carbexp %>% 
  left_join(cope_carbon_meta %>% 
              select(object_id, Depth_5m, Sampled_volume_m3, sample_id),
            by = "object_id") %>% 
  # Calculate abundance fraction represented by the individual
  mutate(abund = (5*1/Sampled_volume_m3)) %>% 
  # Calculate the respired carbon concentration of each individual
  # abundance in m2 * respiration rate in (ug C day-1) * diapause duration (days)
  mutate(tot_c_resp = abund * (respirationRate_ugCs_Tarling* 86400) * diapauseDuration_day_Tarling ) %>% 
  # Calculate the fraction of the "abundance" subjected to overwintering non-predatory mortality (indivs m-2)
  mutate(mort_frac = abund - 
           (abund * exp(beta * diapauseDuration_day_Tarling))) %>% 
  # Calculate the structural carbon and lipid carbon loss to natural mortality (ug C m-2)
  mutate(tot_c_struc_mort = mort_frac * structural_carbon * 1000,
         tot_c_lipid_mort = mort_frac * waxester_carbon * 1000) %>% 
  # Calculate the total carbon flux contribution of the individual (ug C m-2 year-1)
  # TODO note that the diapause duration needs to be correct here!
  mutate(tot_c_flux = tot_c_resp + tot_c_struc_mort + tot_c_lipid_mort)

# total carbon flux per cast (not C is converted to grams)
carbexp_tarling_samples <- carbexp_tarling %>% 
  # TODO can bin by depth 
  group_by(sample_id) %>% 
  summarise(tot_c_flux = sum(tot_c_flux) / 1000 / 1000, # from ug C
            abundance = sum(abund),
            biomass = sum(abund * total_carbon)  / 1000, # from mg C
            tot_c_resp = sum(tot_c_resp) / 1000 / 1000, # from ug C
            tot_c_struc_mort = sum(tot_c_struc_mort) / 1000 / 1000,
            tot_c_lipid_mort = sum(tot_c_lipid_mort) / 1000 / 1000,
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  select(-sample_id) %>% 
  # rename with units
  rename('abundance\n(indivs m-2)' = abundance,
         'biomass\n(gC m-2)' = biomass,
         'total carbon flux\n(gC m-2 yr-1)' = tot_c_flux,
         'total respiration flux\n(gC m-2 yr-1)' = tot_c_resp,
         'total mortality flux structural\n(gC m-2 yr-1)' = tot_c_struc_mort,
         'total mortality flux reserve\n(gC m-2 yr-1)' = tot_c_lipid_mort)

summary(carbexp_tarling_samples)

ggplot(carbexp_tarling_samples %>% 
         pivot_longer(cols = everything(), 
                     names_to = "param", values_to = "value"),
       aes(x = value)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  ylab("N samples") +
  facet_wrap(~param, scales = "free") +
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(size = 12))
# TODO add units (these are indiv/gC m-2 and rates are gC m-2 year-1)


ggsave("figures/UVP6_cflux_terms.png",
       height = 6, width = 10, units = "in", bg = "white")

```

## Spatial distribution of total C flux
```{r}
library(ggOceanMaps)

df0 <- carbexp_tarling_samples %>% 
  left_join(distinct(cope_carbon_meta,
                     sample_id, lon, lat, Year)) %>% 
  mutate(Year = as.factor(Year))

cowplot::plot_grid(
basemap("ArcticStereographic", bathymetry = FALSE, glaciers = TRUE,
        limits = c(-90,-50,65,83), rotate = 10,
        legends = FALSE) +
  ggspatial::geom_spatial_point(data = df0, aes(x = lon, y = lat, 
                                               shape = Year,
                                               fill = biomass),
             size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Total biomass (g C m-2)") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(21, 24), guide = "none") +
  theme(axis.title = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom") +
  guides(fill = guide_colourbar(title.position="top", title.hjust = 0.5)),


basemap("ArcticStereographic", bathymetry = FALSE, glaciers = TRUE,
        limits = c(-90,-50,65,83), rotate = 10,
        legends = FALSE) +
  ggspatial::geom_spatial_point(data = df0, aes(x = lon, y = lat, 
                                               shape = Year,
                                               fill = tot_c_flux),
             size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Total carbon flux (g C m-2 year-1)") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(21, 24), guide = "none") +
  theme(axis.title = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom") +
  guides(fill = guide_colourbar(title.position="top", title.hjust = 0.5)),

labels = "auto"
)


ggsave("figures/UVP6_cflux_spatial_temp.png",
       height = 6, width = 10, units = "in", bg = "white")

# Fraction of biomass that results in total carbon flux
AA <- carbexp_tarling_samples %>% 
  mutate(perc_flux = tot_c_flux / biomass * 100 )
summary(AA$perc_flux)
sd(AA$perc_flux)
```
